verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration REST API, and the Admin CLI (kcadm.sh) scripts realms, users, roles and clients, with the docs saying the same operations are available over the Admin REST API. The SCIM docs also name the Admin Console and the Admin REST API side by side as management paths, and realm JSON import/export plus operator-driven declarative clients add further programmatic coverage. One community user found the API inconsistent and hard to use idempotently, which is a quality complaint rather than a parity gap. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that every Admin Console action is exposed via the API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes at candidate paths returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of full parity.
